title: My Dog Max
text:
My name is Tom. I have a dog. His name is Max. Max is brown and very friendly.

Every morning, Max and I go to the park. We run and play with a ball. Max likes the park very much.

questions.text: What is the name of the dog?
Where do Tom and Max go every morning?
How does Tom probably feel about Max?
Why is Max probably happy in the park?

vocabulary.definition: kind and nice to other people or animals
a green place with grass and trees where people can walk and play
a round object that you throw, kick or catch in games
the colour of wood or chocolate

paragraph_translations: Nazywam się Tom. Mam psa. Jego imię to Max. Max jest brązowy i bardzo przyjazny.
Każdego ranka Max i ja idziemy do parku. Biegamy i bawimy się piłką. Max bardzo lubi park.
